sentences.en: I look at it from an aesthetic point of view.
sentences.zh: 我从美学的角度来看待它。

sentences.en: By architectural symmetry, Emmet means geometric symmetry combined with aesthetic uniformity.
sentences.zh: 埃姆特所说的建筑对称性是指几何对称与审美统一性的结合。

sentences.en: Beauty cannot be determined objectively but depends on personal aesthetic criteria.
sentences.zh: 美无法客观确定，而是取决于个人的审美标准。

senses.zh: 美的，美学的；有关美的；审美的

mnemonic: a+esthe（感觉）+tic→对美有感觉的→美学的
